en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from man, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘

The man strikes a woman, so she dropped the seed’. He<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Upon him is twenty Dinars. So if it was a clot, so upon him is forty Dinars; and if it was a lump, so upon him is sixty Dinars; and if it was bones, so upon him is the (complete) wergild’.
